listing.summary: Contents: Solace faction with some niches focused on firepower and suppression.
listing.aiSummary: Adds the Solace and Enmity factions, exploration content, and superweapons.

description: Introduces the Solace faction, which focuses on firepower and suppression, and the Enmity faction, which specializes in beams and fighters. Includes new ships, encounters, and superweapons. Integrates with Nex for certain features.
descriptionHtml: Introduces the Solace faction, which focuses on firepower and suppression, and the Enmity faction, which specializes in beams and fighters. Includes new ships, encounters, and superweapons. Integrates with Nex for certain features.
discordPostHtml:
Contents:

  • Solace faction with some niches focused on firepower and suppression.
  • Enmity faction focus on beams and fighters.
  • Exploration contents: ships, encounters...
  • Supaweapons
  • Nex integrated (Highly recommend since some feature do require Nex).

Requires MagicLib and LazyLib

Q&A:

  • How do i get Supaweapons?
    • Contact the person in change at the main Solace faction planet, you gotta be in good relation to the faction for the trade option to be unlocked
  • Am i actually a bird ?
    • yes no
Ping me for bugs/feedbacks/complains

Github: https://github.com/CosmicFishi/Project-Solace
Direct Download: https://github.com/CosmicFishi/Project-Solace/releases/download/v0.4.2a/Project-Solace-v0.4.2a.zip
